C = data('kafka.partition.replicas').sum(by=['partition', 'topic', 'host.name']).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = data('kafka.partition.replicas_in_sync').sum(by=['partition', 'topic', 'host.name']).publish(label='D', enable=False)
F = ((C-E)+E).publish(label='F')
E = (C-D).sum(by=['partition', 'topic', 'host.name']).above(0).publish(label='E')

options.markdown:
Kafka consumer group


A Kafka consumer group is a collection of consumers that coordinate to consume messages from Kafka topics, ensuring that each message is processed by only one consumer within the group, which allows for scalable and fault-tolerant message processing.
